title: USB Ports and Charging Access
summary: Feedback on the G70's USB ports centers on requests for different port types and better access, with some praise for rear-seat port placement but several complaints about insufficient or hard-to-find connections.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the placement of rear USB ports and express appreciation for having or wanting USB-A connectivity.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe too few accessible power or USB ports, missing connectivity for CarPlay, and an awkward port location.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention USB-C versus USB-A availability, difficulty locating charging ports, a faulty USB hub reference, and a question about video playback from USB without enough detail to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Many examples are brief or ambiguous, so several fragments cannot be assigned clear sentiment.
Some undetermined fragments appear to be technical or diagnostic notes rather than direct customer opinions.
The topic mixes port type preferences, port location/discoverability, hub faults, and USB media playback, so the examples are not fully coherent as one single issue.
